questions.question: What was the total recorded attendance across all facilities in the dataset over the entire recorded time period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('nys_state_park_annual_attendance.csv')
result = int(df['Attendance'].sum())

questions.question: How many facility records had an attendance count of zero?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('nys_state_park_annual_attendance.csv')
result = int((df['Attendance'] == 0).sum())

questions.question: In 2025, how many visitors went to Green Lakes State Park?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('nys_state_park_annual_attendance.csv')
val = df[(df['Year'] == 2025) & (df['Facility'] == 'Green Lakes State Park')]['Attendance'].iloc[0]
result = int(val)

questions.question: Between Allegany Quaker Area and Allegany Red House Area, which had higher attendance in 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('nys_state_park_annual_attendance.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] == 2025) & (df['Facility'].isin(['Allegany Quaker Area', 'Allegany Red House Area']))]
result = str(sub.sort_values(by='Attendance', ascending=False).iloc[0]['Facility'])

questions.question: Did Robert Moses St Pk - Thousand Islands report more than 200,000 visitors in 2003?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('nys_state_park_annual_attendance.csv')
att = df[(df['Year'] == 2003) & (df['Facility'] == 'Robert Moses St Pk - Thousand Islands')]['Attendance'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if att > 200000 else 'no'
